facts.fact: Ben 家人邻居把 Clara 当恩人团团拥抱感谢；她心里说的是「不是我救了他，是他救了我」。
facts.anchor: I wish I could tell them that I didn’t save Ben. He saved me.

facts.fact: Clara 后怕：如果独自穿越、没有 Ben 的解释和财力，她根本活不下来。
facts.anchor: The what-ifs crowd my brain—what if I’d gone back in time alone?

facts.fact: Ben 对外讲财富来历：结交一位无亲无故的「隐形亿万富翁」，对方几周后去世把钱全留给他（还编了 NDA）。
facts.anchor: “You befriended a closet billionaire with no family who died a few weeks later and left all his money to you?”

facts.fact: 全世界只有他们两个人知道真相——秘密把两人绑得更紧。
facts.anchor: Two people in the whole world know the truth about where Ben’s been, how we met, and how he made his money.

facts.fact: McKinley 那年秋天还是被刺杀了（Ben 回来后查证）；1901 的干预没能改变历史。
Ben 说想念 1901 的平静——能真正写作（在 Clara 来之前）。
facts.anchor: “I miss the actual peace there. I could really write—well, before you came. There was nothing to distract me.”

facts.fact: Ben 在写的小说要重写并改结局——「需要一个 happy ever after」。
facts.anchor: “The story of a guy who feels lost in his life … I’ll have to rewrite it. And I’m going to change the ending.”

facts.fact: 汉堡店里 Ben 查到 William Allen 后来娶了美国女继承人生了个儿子；Clara 脱口说出「Quint」——她记忆里 The Villa 的小男孩正是 William 儿子的名字，她自己都吓一跳。
Mrs. Halloway 结局不好：1904 后再没回 The Villa，晚年与丈夫常年分居。
facts.anchor: She didn’t go back to The Villa after 1904.

facts.fact: Ben 当年在律师那里留了信，若他「消失」就转交 Guthrie 和 William——他早给 1901 的朋友备了告别信。
facts.anchor: I left letters with my lawyer should I ‘disappear’ without much explanation
